personality_one_liner: A vibrant, chunky, and tactile arcade aesthetic capturing the high-energy joy of an endless runner through the historic streets of Istanbul.

spacing.rule: Generous tactile spacing. HUD elements should float slightly away from screen edges (safe area + md padding). Modals and cards should have chunky paddings.

do's: Use heavy blur underneath Game Over sheets and Pause menus so the 3D scene is abstracted but atmospheric behind them.
dont's: Don't blur gameplay HUD elements (score/coins) - these need to be solid, chunky containers for instant readability during fast gameplay.

screens.name: Home / Main Menu
screens.purpose: The gateway to the game, overlays directly on the idle 3D scene.
screens.layout: Transparent full-screen overlay. Top safe area: chunky coin counter and best score pill. Center: Massive 'Oyna' (Play) button with a heavy bottom border (tactile press effect). Bottom: Row of circular icon buttons for Settings, Leaderboard, and Friends.

screens.name: 3D Game Screen & HUD
screens.purpose: Provides instant feedback during high-speed gameplay without blocking the view.
screens.layout: Top Left: Score and Distance in thick, high-contrast containers. Top Right: Pause button. Top Center (or right below safe area): Coin counter. All HUD elements should use surfaceSecondary or brandPrimary solids with borderStrong (thick dark borders) for pop.

screens.name: Game Over Sheet
screens.purpose: Displays run results, celebrates new records, and prompts replay.
screens.layout: Center-aligned modal over a blurred gameplay background. Features a giant score number, coin summary, a 'Yeni Rekor!' (New Record) badge if applicable, and two massive side-by-side buttons: 'Ana Menü' (Home) and 'Tekrar Oyna' (Retry).

screens.name: Friends & Leaderboard
screens.purpose: Social competition hub mimicking Subway Surfers Top Run.

states.empty: Henüz arkadaş eklenmedi (No friends added yet) + Add Friend CTA

screens.layout: Tabbed view (Yerel / Arkadaşlar). Top section has the user's nickname and Friend Code. List items are chunky, highly separated cards showing rank, avatar (initials or random color), name, and score. Rank 1, 2, 3 have gold/silver/bronze tints.

screens.name: Settings & Nickname
screens.layout: Simple bottom sheet or centered modal. Large toggles for Sound/Music. A text input for Nickname with a prominent 'Kaydet' (Save) button.

screens.name: Onboarding Tutorial
screens.purpose: Teaches swipe controls overlaying the first few seconds of a run.
screens.layout: Semi-transparent dark scrim with animated white swipe arrows (Up to jump, Down to roll, Left/Right to switch lanes) and short Turkish hints (Zıpla, Eğil, Sağa/Sola Kay). Dismisses after first successful input.

leaderboard_header.alt: A nostalgic red tram on Istanbul streets, used as atmospheric background for menus

instructions_to_main_agent: 3D Canvas Context: The entire app's background should essentially be the three.js / expo-gl canvas. The Main Menu is just a React Native UI overlaying the 3D scene. Do NOT build the Main Menu as a completely opaque separate screen.

HUD Aesthetic: Subway Surfers is defined by 'chunky' UI. Use borderStrong (#2A2626) to add thick outlines to buttons and score pills. Give primary buttons a bottom border of 4-6px to simulate a physical, tactile 3D button that depresses on touch.

Color Usage: Use 'brand' (#D62828 - Ottoman Red) for primary CTA buttons. Use 'info' (#00A8CC - Bosphorus Blue) for secondary actions or decorative elements. Coins and high-score badges should use 'brandTertiary' (#E9C46A).

Swipe Gestures: Use react-native-gesture-handler (FlingGestureHandler or PanGestureHandler) mapped over the full GL canvas to capture up/down/left/right swipes, driving the 3D character's lane/jump/roll state.
Typography: Use Fredoka for all numbers (scores, coins, distances) and major button labels. Use Nunito for smaller labels, descriptions, and settings text.

Local vs Online Leaderboard: Implement standard AsyncStorage for local top 10. For online friends, a simple mock API structure (or supabase if instructed) where users query a 'friend code' to append to their local list of tracked friends.
Scene Palette (Three.js): Instruct the 3D generation to use a Bosphorus blue skybox/fog, warm Galata stone building colors, and an Ottoman red player/tram obstacle.
